title: Material Requirements & Structural Build Assembly
objective: Implement definition-driven construction requirement/material/structural assembly adapters: MRCS material/component rule references, cost/labor/time/resource request assembly, foundations/walls/floors/roofs/openings/vertical-access placement proposals over MCS spatial bindings, explicit owner-profile structural/support/pressure/fire/etc. evaluation only when definitions provide it, accessible non-pointer placement/editing, and commit/diff/recovery receipts without inventing real-world engineering formulas or duplicate owner state.
acceptance: Construction requirements reference canonical MRCS material/component/rule definitions instead of copying a rules or materials ledger.
Cost, labor, time and resource requirements remain typed requests/references to their canonical Project, Inventory/Asset, MIB-12 and MIB-13 owners.
Foundation, wall, floor, roof, opening and vertical-access placement remains a proposal over MCS spatial bindings until owner-authorized commit.
Structural, support, pressure, fire and comparable requirement evaluation occurs only when an explicit governing owner profile supplies the rule; unsupported behavior remains unresolved.
Pointer and non-pointer construction paths produce equivalent semantic placement proposals.
Commit, diff and recovery receipts preserve Packet-07 distinctions, owner history and explicit versioning without hidden mutation.
Sealed MBES-01 site/project/authority bindings compose without ownership bleed or duplicate World identity.
boundaries: MBES-01 and all upstream completed programs remain sealed.
MRCS retains canonical material, component, structural-rule and reusable-definition authority.
MCS retains map/interior/spatial geometry authority; geometry never becomes construction truth by itself.
APW/D26 retains Project/time authority; Inventory/Asset, MIB-12 and MIB-13 retain resource, transformation and economic transaction authority.
MBES-03 introduces no universal real-world structural, fire, pressure or safety formula.
Unknown or unsupported material/structural behavior remains unresolved.
MBES-03 creates no second materials, Project, resource, World, economy or provenance ledger.
MBES-05 and later MBES tranches remain unauthorized until canonical MBES-03 closeout.
next_action: MBES-03 is completed_verified. MBES-05 — Functional Spaces, Furnishing & Reusable Blueprint Assemblies — is selected_not_started and requires a later owner Continue for governed start.
